name: Windows Installer Always Install Elevated Disabled
description:
Ensures Windows Installer does not install packages with elevated privileges for any user (AlwaysInstallElevated not 1), a well-known local privilege escalation. An absent value passes.
Required Windows permission (remedy only): the LEA agent account must be allowed to run reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer" /v AlwaysInstallElevated (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.

remedy.command: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer" /v AlwaysInstallElevated /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f | Out-Null; reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer" /v AlwaysInstallElevated
